verdict.rationale: Jira's own docs name Slack as a connected tool (tracking progress from Slack, Figma, and Gmail; automation connecting Bitbucket and Slack) and point to 3,000+ Marketplace integrations plus a view of development status inside Jira. However, the evidence never names GitHub or Google Drive, and Marketplace apps are largely third-party rather than native. missing for 10: explicit native GitHub integration evidence, explicit Google Drive integration evidence, depth of native Slack integration, independent/hands-on corroboration
